rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PROTECTION AND PRESERVATION OF PHILIPPINE CULTURAL HERITAGE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Philippine Cultural Heritage Law of 1995" States that the prime duty of the people and the present generation in sustaining and maintaining the fullest meaning of its nationhood is to restore, develop and preserve the nation's cultural properties and attributes. Strengthens the cultural institutions by regulating the transfer of cultural properties and requiring appropriate registration thereof.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-07-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING FIVE HUNDRED PESOS MONTHLY ALLOWANCE TO ALL BARANGAY TANODS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Provides incentives to the barangay tanods who normally deliver the basic services in the barangay heirarchy by granting them a standard monthly allowance of five hundred (P500.00) pesos.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1995-07-26

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 1996-09-26
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF PUBLIC RESTROOMS ALONG NATIONAL HIGHWAYS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Land Transport Support Facilities for Hygiene and Convenience" Mandates the contruction of a public restroom in every thirty (30) kilometer span of the national highways and roads to serve the interests of the riding-public availing of the landcarriers. Directs the barangay where the public restrooms are situated to maintain and sueprvise such facilities.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 1996-09-26, transmitted to on 1996-09-26 and received by the Senate on 1996

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE FILIPINO ACADEMY OF ARTS AND LETTERS, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Academy of Arts and Letters Act of 1995" Provides for an objective of fostering the preservation, enrichment and dynamic evolution of Filipino national culture, based on the principle of unity and diversity, in a climate of free artistic and intellectual expression.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-07-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING THE CODE OF THE NATIONAL FLAG, ANTHEM, MOTTO, COAT-OF-ARMS AND GREAT SEAL OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: "Code of the National Flag, Anthem, Motto, Coat-of-Arms and Great Seal of the Philippines" Prescribes certain deportment for all citizens to observe during flag ceremonies, proper handling of the flag, remembering the substance of the Motto, livingup to the Coat-of-Arms and the Great Seal of the Philippines by proudly displaying them within the context of prudence and propriety.
rows.status: Substituted by HB02586

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 1996-06-06
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 1996-06-06, transmitted to on 1996-06-06 and received by the Senate on 1996
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE SCIENTIFIC CAREER SYSTEM
rows.abstract: Revitalizes and enhances the implementation of the Scientific Career System (SCS) to ensure continued attraction and retention of scientific manpower in the conduct of research and development, foster scientific productivity, recognize and reward qualified scientific and technologists.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05730

rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING A MOTOR VEHICLE TAX ON MOTOR VEHICLES, INCLUDING TRAILERS AND SIDECARS, CLASSIFIED AS "PRIVATE" AND "FOR HIRE," AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR LATE OR DELINQUENT PAYMENT THEREOF
rows.abstract: Updates the private motor vehicle tax under Executive Order No. 43 by imposing a similar tax on motor vehicles classified as "for hire."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1995-07-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXPANDING THE LIST OF NON-ESSENTIAL GOODS SUBJECT TO EXCISE TAX TO INCLUDE OTHER FORMS OF AFFLUENT CONSUMPTION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 150 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Expands the list of non-essential goods and services and on affluent consumption which should be subjected to excise taxation in order to optimize its impact and enhance the progressivity of the tax system.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1995-07-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7716, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE EXPANDED VALUE ADDED TAX LAW
rows.abstract: Rectifies the possibilities of adverse effects of the expanded value-added tax law, Republic Act No. 7716, by adjusting the exemptions from VAT of the: (1) non-electric cooperatives composed primarily of small producers and/or consumers; (2) circulation and advertising revenues of newspapers; and (3) leasing of residential units at a monthly rental not exceeding P12,500 per unit, and by providing for a presumptive input tax to be availed by construction contractors, owners of buildings or buildings with machineries permanently attached therein and agro-processors .
rows.status: Substituted by HB05479

rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING A TAX ON THE SALE OF STOCK WARRANTS OR OPTIONS, BONDS, DEBENTURES AND OTHER SECURITIES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 124-A OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7717
rows.abstract: Aims to raise revenues and to create a local bond of market with the impostion of a tax on the sale, barter or exchange of stock warrants or options, bonds, debentures and other securities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1995-07-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR TAX EXEMPTION OF COMPENSATION INCOME DERIVED DURING THE TAXABLE YEAR BY A NON-RESIDENT CITIZEN FROM SOURCES WITHOUT THE PHILIPPINES AMOUNTING TO THIRTY THOUSAND U.S. DOLLARS (US$30,000), AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 21 AND44 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Encourages the remittance of foreign currencies through the banking system and accredited couriers, ensuring an adequate foreign currency reserve for the government.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09077

rows.title_full: AN ACT LOWERING TO THREE PERCENT (3%) THE RATES OF IMPORT DUTY ON CERTAIN TARIFF HEADINGS AFFECTING THE PHILIPPINE JEWELLERY INDUSTRY, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 104 OF THE TARIFF AND CUSTOMS CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Proposes to provide further request to the local jewellery industry by fixing the customs duty rates for imported raw materials for fine jewelry production at THREE PER CENT (3%).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1995-07-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE MAGNA CARTA OF THE URBAN POOR, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to make the concern for the urban poor a mandatory function of government; underscores the basic rights of the urban poor, such as: (1) the right to employment and livelihood; (2) right to financial assistance and credit; (3) right to organizeand be heard.
